plain_english: Bow to the three-worlds' Lord, ash-white, three-eyed, trident-bearing, snake-threaded, moon-crested.
sanskrit_cite: nathaṃ tribhuvananāthaṃ bhūtisitaṃ trinayanaṃ triśūladharam upavītīkṛtabhoginam indukalāśekharaṃ vande

plain_english: I praise, self-forgetting, white-robed in bite-torn cloth, dancing to the tune of the skull-garland.
sanskrit_cite: naumi nijatanuvinismaradaṃśukapariveṣadhavalaparidhānam vilasatkapālamālākalpitanṛttotsavākalpam

plain_english: Bow to those whose god is Hara, whose acts are Hara-fit, whose lives lean wholly to Hara — the fortunate abodes.
sanskrit_cite: vande tān daivataṃ yeṣāṃ haraś ceṣṭā harocitāḥ haraikapravaṇāḥ prāṇāḥ sadā saubhāgyasadmanām

plain_english: Your play, behind lordship — and this too, as wished-fulfilled in gifts, by self I reach the supreme means.
sanskrit_cite: krīḍitaṃ tava maheśvaratāyāḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nyad idam eva yathaitat iṣṭamātraghaṭiteṣv avadāneṣv ātmanā param upāyam upaimi

plain_english: In Your world-venerated abode, in this play — how great would my bliss-birth be?
sanskrit_cite: tvaddhāmni viśvavandye 'sminn iyati krīḍane sati tava nātha kiyān bhūyānn ānandarasasambhavaḥ

plain_english: How could He not be fortunate — Hara, Gauri's beloved? And how could Hara not be Gauri's supreme beloved?
sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ sa subhago mā bhūdyo gauryā vallabho haraḥ haro 'pi mā bhūd atha kiṃ gauryāḥ paramavallabhaḥ

plain_english: Whose meditation-nectar is undying, self-rooted, ever-fresh consciousness-creepers, like some tree of being.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānāmṛtamayaṃ yasya svātmamūlam anaśvaram saṃvillatās tathārūpās tasya kasyāpi sattaroḥ

plain_english: At devotion-itch's showing, Lord's pillar-firmness arises — by it the world, great festival, is won.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktikaṇḍūsam ullāsāvasare parameśvara mahānikaṣapāṣāṇasthūṇā pūjaiva jāyate

plain_english: Ever to creation-sport, ever seated in staying-pleasure, ever world-eating-sated — to the husband, bow.
sanskrit_cite: sadā srṣṭivinodāya sadā sthitisukhāsine sadā tribhuvanāhāratṛptāya svāmine namaḥ

plain_english: Nowhere gone, nothing left — who see Your abode as to-be here, fortunate: bow to them.
sanskrit_cite: na kvāpi gatvā hitvāpi na kiṃcid idam eva ye bhavyaṃ tvaddhāma paśyanti bhavyās tebhyo namo namaḥ

plain_english: For the devotion-fortuned, what else is begged; for the devotion-poor, what else is begged?
sanskrit_cite: bhaktilakṣmīsamṛddhānāṃ kim anyad upayācitam etayā vā daridraṇāṃ kim anyad upayācitam

plain_english: Where pains turn pleasures, poison turns nectar, saṃsāra turns liberation — that path is Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: duḥkhāny api sukhāyante viṣam apy amṛtāyate mokṣāyate ca saṃsāro yatra mārgaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ

plain_english: At root, middle, end, no suffering for Your people — yet we sink, Lord: tell why.
sanskrit_cite: mūle madhye 'vasāne ca nāsti duḥkhaṃ bhavajjuṣāṃ tathāpi vayam īśāna sīdāmaḥ katham ucyatām

plain_english: Light is worth begging even by others, beginners in knowledge-yoga — You, Lord of devotees, are like the light of the free.
sanskrit_cite: jñānayogādinānyeṣām apy apekṣitum arhati prakāśaḥ svairiṇām iva bhavān bhaktimatāṃ prabho

plain_english: Devotees have no prayers, no remembrance of You the self — yet this "Śiva" of theirs, something, on the lip.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ nārtayo nāpy asty ādhyānaṃ svātmanas tava tathāpy asti śivety etat kim apy eṣāṃ bahirmukhe

plain_english: Who lights all appearances, wrapped in vimarśa — "I am this": I praise Your action-power, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: sarvābhāsāvabhāso yo vimarśavalito 'khilam aham etad iti staumi tāṃ kriyāśaktim īśa te

plain_english: All beings, from Brahmā to Viṣṇu, being devoured — so I bow, God, to the world as Your-formed.
sanskrit_cite: vartante jantavo 'śeṣā api brahmendraviṣṇavaḥ grasamānās tato vande deva viśvaṃ bhavanmayam

plain_english: All beyond Me is false, by relation to destruction — thus engaged, Lord, by Your destruction-play alone.
sanskrit_cite: sato vināśasambandhān matparaṃ nikhilaṃ mṛṣā evamevodyate nātha tvayā saṃhāralīlayā

plain_english: Meditated, Your form stands present for devotion-rich — unconquered by unthinkable-wonder-makers.
sanskrit_cite: dhyātam ātmupatiṣṭhata eva tvadvapur varada bhaktidhanānām apy acintyam akhilādbhutacintākartṛtāṃ prati ca te vijayante

plain_english: By Your devotion-wine-taste nerves' thrill, night-heroes dance, roused by vetālas.
sanskrit_cite: tāvakabhaktirasāsavasekād iva sukhitamarmamaṇḍalasphuritaiḥ nṛtyati vīrajano niśi vetālakulaiḥ kṛtotsāhaḥ

plain_english: The praise begun with this limb of mine — by it may all this time be firmly unending.
sanskrit_cite: ārabdhā bhavadabhinutir amunā yenāṅgakena mama śambho tenāparyantam imaṃ kālaṃ dṛḍham akhilam eva bhaviṣīṣṭa
